name: coll_col_tile_mgc-ct6c-81025983b
purpose: q13-coll root cause of the residual M4 DRC at macro E edges (ct1-ct5 / slab c1-c4): VIA45 dropped from an M5 track over the macro interior next to a 24 nm M4 edge pin; its M4 landing sits 13-53 nm from (or crosses) the wide M4 OBS that ends 72 nm inside the edge. Physical fix: temporary M5 route keepout over the macro pin-edge band (created pre-GRT, removed post-DRT, asserted count) so every macro pin is entered planar on its own M4 track from the channel; LEF OBS, M5 cap, SDC unchanged. Variant c: M5 keepout over the whole macro (no net needs to cross a macro in this 25%-util leaf); ct5 kit otherwise.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_coll_col_tile u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_col_tile.sv && echo lint-ok
